title: 第一卷 第8章 恋人一般的情人
content_zh:
童喻喉咙发紧。

    她这会儿知道，他说的是实话。

    言外之意，他想和她玩一玩。

    童喻没想过当谁的情人，哪怕是在自己最难的时候，她也没有想过。

    “情人”这两个字在她的认知里，是不被认可的。

    但是，霍放没有结婚，没有女朋友。

    她也可以理解为，是恋人一般的情人。

    只不过，他们之间缺了“情”这个字。

    童喻不想钻牛角尖，更没有想过他对她会产生感情。

    如他所说，顶多就是喜欢她这具肉身而已。

    霍放很坦诚。

    “二少准备玩多久？”

    没有感情，但是彼此真诚一点，倒也无妨。

    霍放真的很欣赏童喻，长得漂亮，大胆还聪明。

    和聪明的女人说话，就是很省心。

    “难说。”

    霍放目光落在她的纹身上，“还有，之前我跟你提过，当我的女人，不容易。你自己想好。”

    童喻在认真想。

    “可以考虑一下吗？”

    霍放闻言，盯着她片刻，轻笑一声，从她身上起来，整理好衣服，如同谦谦君子般。

    他微微挑眉，“当然。”

    童喻也坐了起来。

    两个人之前暧昧的气氛，瞬间归于平静。

    。

    童喻回到了出租屋。

    冯姿下了班就拎着外卖来了她家，看到她心事重重，问了一句。

    童喻把霍放说的话跟冯姿说了。

    “他确实挺坦诚的。”冯姿看了眼童喻，“没有玩弄感情，这么直白，倒也称得上是君子。”

    童喻笑，“是。”

    霍放从开始都没有为难过她，这一点让她对他的印象好几分。

    “不过，也说明他这个人的心是有些花的。”冯姿把外卖盖子掀开，“他玩女人的手段很高明。难怪说和他分手的女人没有一个说过他坏话的。”

    童喻拿起一次性筷子，端起了面前的饭，“我需要他的身份。”

    冯姿明白，“反正人都要谈恋爱的。和他这样的男人谈，就算没有感情，也不亏。不过，他说的情人，是女朋友的意思吧。”

    童喻也不知道。

    应该是吧。

    不是谈地下的，而是明面上的，不是女朋友，是什么呢？

    “不管那么多，你现在就好好赚钱。赚钱是王道。”冯姿吃着土豆丝，“要是能在跟着他的这段时间把他的心拿下，那个时候吴叔看病的钱，就有着落了。你就可以去做你想做的事了。”

    童喻细嚼慢咽，舌尖轻扫了一下嘴唇，淡淡一笑，“拿他的心……就不去想了。”

    自知之明，这一点她还是有的。

    越是有钱有身份的人，越看重门当户对。

    童喻从一开始就没有想过真能够和霍放谈一段走心的恋爱。
content_en:
Tong Yu's throat tightened.

    She knew now that he was telling the truth.

    The implication is that he wants to play with her.

    Tong Yu never thought about being someone's lover, even when she was in the most difficult time, she never thought about it.

    The word "lover" is not recognized in her mind.

    However, Huo Fang is not married and has no girlfriend.

    She can also be understood as a lover like a lover.

    However, the word "love" is missing between them.

    Tong Yu didn't want to get into trouble, and she never thought that he would have feelings for her.

    As he said, at most he just likes her body.

    Huo Fang is very candid.

    "How long are you going to play, Second Young Master?"

    There is no emotion, but it doesn't hurt to be sincere to each other.

    Huo Fang really admires Tong Yu, he is beautiful, bold and smart.

    Talking to a smart woman is easy.

    "Hard to say."

    Huo Fang's eyes fell on her tattoo, "Also, I mentioned to you before that it is not easy to be my woman. You decide for yourself."

    Tong Yu is thinking seriously.

    "Can you think about it?"

    Hearing this, Huo Fang stared at her for a moment, chuckled, got up from her, straightened his clothes, like a humble gentleman.

    He raised his eyebrows slightly, "Of course."

    Tong Yu also sat up.

    The ambiguous atmosphere between the two people before suddenly calmed down.

    .

    Tong Yu returned to the rental house.

    Feng Zi came to her house with takeout after work. Seeing that she was worried, she asked.

    Tong Yu told Feng Zi what Huo Fang said.

    "He is indeed quite candid." Feng Zi glanced at Tong Yu, "He didn't play with emotions. He is so straightforward, so he can be called a gentleman."

    Tong Yu smiled, "Yes."

    Huo Fang never felt sorry for her from the beginning, which made her have a better impression of him.

    "However, it also shows that he is a bit carefree." Feng Zi opened the lid of the takeaway, "He is very clever at playing with women. No wonder none of the women who broke up with him said anything bad about him."

    Tong Yu picked up the disposable chopsticks and picked up the rice in front of him, "I need his identity."

    Feng Zi understood, "Everyone has to fall in love anyway. Even if you don't have feelings for a man like him, it's not a loss. However, when he talks about lover, he probably means girlfriend."

    Tong Yu doesn't know either.

    Probably so.

    It's not about the secret, but the public. It's not a girlfriend, what is it?

    "No matter how much, you make money now. Making money is king." Feng Zi ate shredded potatoes. "If you can win his heart while following him, then Uncle Wu's money for medical treatment will be settled. You can do what you want to do."

    Tong Yu chewed slowly, swiped his lips with the tip of his tongue, and smiled lightly, "I don't think about it... I won't think about it."

    She still has self-awareness.

    The richer and more prestigious a person is, the more they value being well-matched.

    From the beginning, Tong Yu never thought that she could have a serious love relationship with Huo Fang.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 8 A Lover Like a Lover
